# hi-data-model-discovery: guide

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Produce draft-only evidence-backed physical and logical data models, ERDs, entity and field inventories, data dictionaries, ownership, read/write access, lifecycle, sensitivity, caching, replication, and migration gaps. Do not execute schema migrations or present inferred relationships as declared constraints.

## Invocation

```text
/hi-data-model-discovery <database | module | entity scope> — draft-only
```

## Boundaries

- Do not execute schema migrations or present inferred relationships as declared constraints.
- An inferred foreign key, cardinality, owner, or retention policy never becomes a declared constraint.

- Evidence Gate
